title: 第0009章姜影引路第0010章心火燃城
content_zh:
第0009章姜影引路通风管道狭窄低矮，铁皮壁上凝着厚厚的霜。巴刀鱼三人背着六名昏迷的“饲奴”，在黑暗中匍匐前行。身后冷库方向，警报声如潮水般退去，取而代之的是某种低沉的嗡鸣，像是无数人在同一时间低声诵念。
娃娃鱼突然停住：“他们……在重组‘饲网’。那些被我们救出的人，只是‘饲’的容器。真正的源头，还在动。”
巴刀鱼咬牙，掌心那瓣姜紧贴皮肤，竟传来一丝温润的凉意，稍稍压制了体内狂暴的火煞与命火的灼烧。他低头看手，皮肤上的裂痕仍在渗血，火光在皮下明灭，像随时会炸开。
“撑住。”酸菜汤背着他，声音沙哑，“黄片姜……不会无缘无故现身。他既然引路，就一定有路。”
“可我们去哪儿？”娃娃鱼问。
“去‘缝’里。”巴刀鱼低语，“他要我们去‘玄界缝隙’。”
酸菜汤一愣：“你疯了？那是非人之地！进去的活物，没一个能完整出来！”
“可我们救的人，是‘饲’从缝里捞出来的。”巴刀鱼盯着前方黑暗，“他们能进，我们就能出。而且……”他摸了摸掌心的姜片，“他给的，是‘引路符’。”
娃娃鱼闭眼，指尖轻触那瓣姜。
片刻后，她睁眼，瞳孔微缩：“这姜……有‘记忆’。它带我们去一个地方——老城区，**地下排水总管**。那里有最大的‘缝’，也是‘饲’的集散中心。”
“走。”巴刀鱼咬牙。
他们继续爬行，终于从一处废弃的检修口滑下。
眼前是巨大的地下空间——城市排水总管的主干道。水泥通道高五米，宽十米，两侧是污水渠，黑水缓缓流淌，泛着油光。头顶管道如蛛网，滴着冷凝水。
可此刻，这里已不是排水道。
通道两侧，搭满了临时摊位。摊主全是黑袍人，戴着食材面具，贩卖着诡异的“食材”——
“**记忆鱼**”：鱼眼是人眼，泡在玻璃缸里，据称能吃出死者临终记忆。
“**情绪菇**”：菌盖上浮着人脸，吃一口，能让人陷入狂喜或绝望。
“**魂肉**”：切成薄片的肉，每一片都在微微跳动，像还活着。
“**梦汤**”：锅里煮着头发和指甲，香气诱人，喝了会永远沉睡。
叫卖声此起彼伏，买家形形色色——有穿西装的白领，有戴红领巾的学生，甚至还有穿制服的警察。他们眼神空洞，机械地付钱、取货、吞食，然后转身离开，背影迅速消失在黑暗中。

“这是……‘饲市’。”娃娃鱼声音发颤，“他们把‘缝’里的东西，运到这里，卖给城里人。整座城市，正在被一点点吃掉。”
“不止是吃。”巴刀鱼盯着那些吞食“魂肉”的人，“是在替换。吃下去的不是营养，是‘饲’的种子。等种子发芽，他们就不再是人。”
酸菜汤啐了一口：“妈的，这哪是市场？这是屠宰场！”
“别出声。”娃娃鱼突然拉住他们，“有‘眼’。”
她指向头顶管道。
那里，悬挂着数十颗“灯泡”——
其实是**人头**。
被剥去皮肤，眼球挖出，插上电线，空洞的眼眶里闪烁着红光，缓缓转动，扫视全场。
“监控。”巴刀鱼低语，“他们在看。”
“可黄片姜让我们来。”酸菜汤不解，“这是送死。”
“不。”巴刀鱼盯着前方，“他不是让我们硬闯。是让我们……看。”
他指向市场尽头。
那里有一座高台，台上放着一口巨锅。锅身漆黑，刻满符文，锅下无火，可锅中汤却在沸腾，汤色漆黑如墨，不断有黑气溢出，凝成一张张痛苦的人脸，随即被锅吸回。
锅旁，站着一人。
穿灰袍，戴“姜”字面具，手持青铜勺，正缓缓搅动黑汤。
content_en:
Chapter 0009 Jiang Ying’s guide ventilation duct is narrow and low, with thick frost on the iron walls. The three of them crawled forward in the darkness carrying six unconscious "feeding slaves" on their backs. Behind him, in the direction of the cold storage, the sirens receded like a tide, replaced by some kind of low hum, like countless people chanting in low voices at the same time.
Salamander suddenly stopped: "They... are reorganizing the 'feeding net'. Those people we rescued are just containers for 'feeding'. The real source is still moving."
The swordfish gritted his teeth, and the ginger in his palm was close to the skin, and there was a warm and cool feeling, which slightly suppressed the violent fire evil and the burning of the life fire in the body. He looked down at his hands. The cracks on his skin were still oozing blood, and the fire was flickering under his skin, as if it would explode at any time.
"Hold on." Pickled cabbage soup carried him on his back, his voice hoarse, "Huang Pianjiang... won't show up for no reason. Since he leads the way, there must be a way."
"But where are we going?" Baby Fish asked.
"Go to the 'gap'." Basio fish whispered, "He wants us to go to the 'gap of the mysterious world'."
Pickled cabbage soup was stunned: "Are you crazy? That is an inhumane place! Not a single living creature that went in could come out intact!"
"But the people we rescued were fished out of the cracks by 'feeders.'" Batio fish stared at the darkness ahead, "If they can get in, we can get out. And..." He touched the ginger slices in his palm, "What he gave them was a 'guide talisman.'"
The baby fish closed its eyes and touched the ginger lightly with her fingertips.
After a moment, she opened her eyes and her pupils shrank: "This ginger... has a 'memory'. It takes us to a place - the old city, **underground drainage main pipe**. There is the largest 'gap' there, and it is also the distribution center of 'feeding'."
"Let's go." Batio fish gritted his teeth.
They continued to crawl and finally slid down an abandoned manhole.
In front of us is a huge underground space - the main road of the city's sewerage main. The cement channel is five meters high and ten meters wide, with sewage channels on both sides. Black water flows slowly and shines with oil. The pipes overhead were like spider webs, dripping with condensation.
But at this moment, this is no longer a drainage channel.
Both sides of the passage were lined with temporary stalls. The stall owners are all men in black robes, wearing ingredients masks, selling weird "ingredients"——
"**Memory Fish**": Fish eyes are human eyes, soaked in a glass tank, and are said to be able to eat the dying memories of the deceased.
"**Emotional Mushroom**": A human face floats on the mushroom cap. Taking a bite can make people fall into ecstasy or despair.
"**Soul Meat**": Thinly sliced ​​meat, each piece is beating slightly, as if it is still alive.
"**Dream Soup**": Hair and nails are boiling in the pot. The aroma is alluring. Drinking it will make you fall asleep forever.
There were shouts of hawking, and there were all kinds of buyers—white-collar workers in suits, students in red scarves, and even police officers in uniform. Their eyes were empty as they mechanically paid, picked up, and ate, then turned and left, their backs quickly disappearing into the darkness.
"This is... the 'feeding market'." Baby Fish's voice trembled, "They transport the things in the 'slit' here and sell them to the people in the city. The whole city is being eaten bit by bit."
"It's more than just eating." Basio looked at those who swallowed the "soul meat." "It's replacing. What they eat is not nutrition, but the seeds of 'feeding'. When the seeds germinate, they will no longer be human."
Pickled cabbage soup spat: "Damn, where is this market? This is a slaughterhouse!"
"Don't make any noise." Baby Fish suddenly pulled them, "It has 'eyes'."
She pointed to the overhead pipe.
There are dozens of "light bulbs" hanging there——
Actually it's **head**.
The skin was peeled off, the eyeballs were gouged out, and wires were plugged in. The empty eye sockets flashed with red light, slowly turning, and scanning the entire scene.
"Surveillance," the batfish whispered. "They're watching."
"But Huang Pianjiang asked us to do it." Pickled cabbage soup was puzzled, "This is sending death."
"No." Batio fish stared ahead, "He didn't ask me toThey forced their way in. Let's...see. "
He points to the end of the market.
There was a high platform there, with a huge pot on it. The body of the pot is pitch black and engraved with runes. There is no fire under the pot, but the soup in the pot is boiling. The soup is as black as ink, and black air is constantly overflowing, forming painful human faces, which are then sucked back by the pot.
Beside the pot, there was a person standing.
Wearing a gray robe and a "ginger" mask, holding a bronze spoon, he was slowly stirring the black soup.
